diagram_candidates.kind: TikZ right-weak-order fiber chain with endpoint/projection maps
diagram_candidates.why_warranted: The item foregrounds a concrete three-element fiber and states that fibers are weak-order intervals with constant lower and upper projection endpoints.
diagram_candidates.specific_content: Draw the chain s3 <_R s3s2 <_R s3s2s1; show pi_c mapping all three vertices to s3 and u_c mapping them to s3s2s1. Keep the convention c=s1s2s3 and right-to-left composition visible.
diagram_candidates.status: potentially warranted; illustration would clarify this one concrete interval, while the prose is already complete.
diagram_candidates.mathematical_check: The source explicitly gives the interval [s3,s3s2s1] and the three elements; no contradiction found.

existing_diagram_checks.review: No TikZ diagram is present in the assigned HTML render metadata (all 36 report tikz_count 0); consequently there were no existing drawn diagram orientations, labels or arrows to validate. Checked the diagram-like A3 tables/maps and the rank-two I2(5) root/mu matrix: the stated right-to-left convention, c=s1s2s3=(1 2 3 4), right-weak-order chain orientation, fiber endpoints, and displayed signs/one-step zeros were internally consistent in the inspected examples.
existing_diagram_checks.limitations: This was a read-only local review of the frozen assignment snapshots, HTML, and local screenshot tiles. No HTTP/live website was accessed; no items, apps, renderer, publication state, tests/builds, or commits were changed.
